templates.pattern: [P1] walks [D1] km North, turns right and walks [D2] km, turns right and walks [D3] km, turns right and walks [D4] km. How far and in which direction is [P1] from start?
templates.explanation: N[D1]→E[D2]→S[D3]→W[D4]. Net North=[D1-D3], Net East=[D2-D4]. Distance=√(([D1-D3])²+([D2-D4])²)

templates.pattern: [P1] starts from point A facing North. Walks [D1] km, turns left, walks [D2] km, turns left, walks [D3] km. What direction does [P1] face and how far is [P1] from A (East-West only)?
templates.explanation: North→left=West[D2]→left=South[D3]. Now facing South. East-West displacement = [D2] km West.

templates.pattern: [P1] is at position O. [P2] is [D1] km North of O. [P3] is [D2] km East of [P2]. [P4] is [D1] km South of [P3]. How far is [P4] from O?
templates.explanation: O → N[D1] = [P2] → E[D2] = [P3] → S[D1] = [P4]. North and South cancel. [P4] is [D2] km East of O.

templates.pattern: [P1] walks [D1] km East, turns left, walks [D2] km, turns left, walks [D3] km, turns left, walks [D4] km. In which direction must [P1] walk to return to start?
templates.explanation: E[D1]→N[D2]→W[D3]→S[D4]. Net East=[D1-D3], Net North=[D2-D4]. To return: go West and South. Direction = South-West.

templates.pattern: [P1] and [P2] start from same point. [P1] walks [D1] km North then [D2] km East. [P2] walks [D2] km East then [D1] km North. How far apart are [P1] and [P2]?
templates.explanation: Both end at the same point (N[D1]+E[D2] = E[D2]+N[D1]). They are 0 km apart.

templates.pattern: [P1] walks [D1] km towards North-East, then turns and walks [D1] km towards South-East. In which direction is [P1] from the starting point?
templates.explanation: NE gives equal North and East components. SE gives equal South and East components. North and South cancel. Net movement is East only.

templates.pattern: A man walks [D1] km North, then [D2] km North-East (45°). What is the total Northward distance covered? (North component of NE = [D2]×0.7 ≈ [D2]/√2)
templates.explanation: North component of NE ([D2] km at 45°) = [D2]/√2 ≈ [D2]×0.707. Total North = [D1] + [D2]/√2

templates.pattern: [P1] starts from school, walks [D1] km West to park, then [D2] km North to library, then [D3] km East to home. In which direction is home from school, and how far?
templates.explanation: Net East = [D3-D1]. Net North = [D2]. Distance = √(([D3-D1])²+[D2]²)

templates.pattern: [P1] is facing South-West. Turns 90 degrees clockwise. Which direction does [P1] face now?
templates.explanation: SW + 90° clockwise = NW.

templates.pattern: [P1] starts from O, walks [D1] km East to A, then [D2] km North to B, then [D1] km West to C, then [D2] km South back. [P2] starts from O and walks [D3] km directly to C. What direction does [P2] walk?
templates.explanation: [P1] returns to O (complete rectangle). C is at same latitude as O. [P2] walks from O directly — C is at E[D1],N[D2] then W[D1]=O horizontally, N[D2]. So C = North of O. [P2] walks North.

templates.pattern: [P1] faces North. Turns right 3 times. [P2] faces South. Turns left 3 times. Do they face the same direction?
templates.explanation: [P1]: N→E→S→W (3 right turns). [P2]: S→E→N→W (3 left turns). Both face West. Yes, same direction.

templates.pattern: [P1] walks [D1] km North, [D2] km West, [D3] km South, [D4] km East. What is [P1]'s displacement from start?
templates.explanation: Net North=[D1-D3], Net West=[D2-D4]. Displacement=√(([D1-D3])²+([D2-D4])²)

templates.pattern: [P1] is [D1] km West of [P2]. [P3] is [D2] km North of [P1]. [P4] is [D1] km East of [P3]. How far and in which direction is [P4] from [P2]?
templates.explanation: [P2] at origin. [P1] is W[D1]. [P3] is N[D2] of [P1] = W[D1]+N[D2]. [P4] is E[D1] of [P3] = back to same longitude as [P2], at N[D2]. So [P4] is [D2] km North of [P2].

templates.pattern: [P1] walks from home [D1] km East to shop, then [D2] km North to office, then [D3] km West to gym. What is the shortest path from gym back to home?
templates.explanation: Gym is at W[D3-D1] and N[D2] from home. Distance = √(([D3-D1])²+[D2]²)

templates.pattern: A clock is placed on a wall. The minute hand points East at 3 o'clock position. Which direction does the hour hand point at 12 o'clock?
templates.explanation: 3 o'clock = East. 12 o'clock is 90° anticlockwise from 3. East rotated 90° anticlockwise = North.

templates.pattern: [P1] walks [D1] km in the direction of South-West, then turns and walks [D1] km North-West. In which direction is [P1] from the starting point?
templates.explanation: SW has equal S and W components. NW has equal N and W components. S and N cancel. Net is West only. [P1] is to the West.

templates.pattern: [P1] and [P2] start from the same point. [P1] walks [D1] km North and [D2] km East. [P2] walks [D3] km South and [D4] km West. How far apart are they?
templates.explanation: [P1] at N[D1]+E[D2]. [P2] at S[D3]+W[D4]. Total N-S gap=[D1+D3]. Total E-W gap=[D2+D4]. Distance=√(([D1+D3])²+([D2+D4])²)

templates.pattern: [P1] stands at the centre of a square field with sides facing North, South, East, West. Walks to the North-East corner. What is the direction from the North-East corner back to the centre?
templates.explanation: From NE corner, the centre is in the South-West direction.

templates.pattern: [P1] walks [D1] km North, turns 45 degrees right (North-East direction), walks [D2] km. Which general direction is [P1] from start?
templates.explanation: Walking North then North-East keeps [P1] in the North-East quadrant from start. Direction is North-East.

templates.pattern: [P1] is [D1] km North of [P2]. [P3] is [D2] km West of [P2]. [P4] is [D1] km South of [P3]. How far is [P4] from [P1] and in which direction?
templates.explanation: [P1] at N[D1] of [P2]. [P3] at W[D2] of [P2]. [P4] at S[D1] of [P3] = same latitude as [P2], W[D2]. [P1] is at N[D1]+E[D2] from [P4]. Distance = √([D1]²+[D2]²)... Actually [P1] is at [P2]+N[D1], [P4] is at [P2]+W[D2]. Distance=√([D1]²+[D2]²).

templates.pattern: [P1] takes 3 left turns starting from North. Each turn is 90°. Which direction does [P1] face finally?
templates.explanation: North → left(W) → left(S) → left(E). After 3 left turns = East.

templates.pattern: [P1] walks [D1] km East, turns left, walks [D2] km, turns left, walks [D3] km. Final position relative to start: how far East/West?
templates.explanation: E[D1]→N[D2]→W[D3]. Net East = [D1]-[D3]. Facing West.

templates.pattern: A man goes [D1] km East, then [D2] km South-East (45°). What is the total Eastward distance from start? (East component of SE = [D2]/√2)
templates.explanation: East component of SE[D2] = [D2]/√2. Total East = [D1] + [D2]/√2

templates.pattern: [P1] starts from A. Walks [D1] km North to B. Turns right, walks [D2] km to C. Turns right, walks [D3] km to D. Turns right, walks [D4] km to E. How far is E from A and in which direction?
templates.explanation: N[D1]→E[D2]→S[D3]→W[D4]. Net N=[D1-D3], Net E=[D2-D4]. D3=D2 so net E=0. Distance=|D1-D3| North.

templates.pattern: [P1] and [P2] face each other. [P1] faces North. [P2] turns 90 degrees to the right. Which direction does [P2] now face?
templates.explanation: [P1] faces North → [P2] faces South (opposite). [P2] turns right from South → West.
